_readme: Mode-A eval for the DCF assumption prompt (v3), graded by code in src/evals/dcf_assumptions.py. Each case pins a synthetic company context in the production format; no real issuer data. Checks: production guardrail (complete assumption records and consensus comparison), value bounds supported by the pinned evidence, no capture-gap metric cited as a reported fact or calculation, and confidence ceilings for thin evidence. Re-run: python execution/run_llm_evals.py --purpose dcf_assumptions --mode golden --min-score 0.8

cases.note: Five steady years at 7-8% growth; units +5% and price +2.5% a year. Consensus implies +18%. The forecast must follow the drivers and explain the gap, not adopt consensus.
